reader_note: The value covers the board-size change (13 to 12, Hippeau not standing), Chairman David Marriott and Lead Independent Director Henderson, the independence determinations, the six standing committees with all five committee pages plus the Executive Committee sentence, and the Audit and HRCC report signatures; two selected blocks state none (1537, one of McCarthy's other public company boards; 1583, Reid's biography). Every pool composition fact - the summary nominee table (its MEMBER/CHAIR cells carry no committee name in the text, so columns were read from cell order, matching the committee pages), the twelve cards' committee fields and status labels, the leadership text and graphic, and repeated '12 nominees' counts - is restated by a selected block; the explicit Chairman/CEO separation (since 2012) is only in pool 996/997, conveyed in the value by 998 (a non-employee Chairman working with the President and CEO). Read as stating none: the cards' tenure fields ('Joined the Board: 2023' for Hobart and Reid, 'Lead Independent Director since: 2022'), the honorary Chairman/Director Emeritus titles of non-directors (1046/1047), and the diversity matrix's 'Total Number of Directors', whose number is not in the packet text.
